query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  SUM(cat9) as total_cat9,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cat9 > 0 THEN data END) as dias_com_cat9
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-28'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
